title: Kenyan Vegan Mincemeat Pilaf
description: A unique twist on traditional pilaf, incorporating sweet and tangy Kenyan mincemeat for a flavorful vegan dish.

ingredients.name: outstandingly
ingredients.amount: 1 tablespoon (note: outstandingly is an adjective, not an ingredient)

instructions: Heat buttery substitute in a pan over medium heat.
Add pilaf and cook until lightly toasted.
Stir in Kenyan mincemeat and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
